ios.desc:
ZenTrack is a simple yet powerful app designed to help you stay on top of your life. Whether you are managing tasks, tracking expenses, or monitoring your health, ZenTrack keeps everything organized in one place.

ZenTrack has four main sections: productivity, finance, fitness and Streaks.

Terms Of Use - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

In the productivity section, you can create, organize, and manage your to-do lists effortlessly. The intuitive layout helps you keep track of tasks easily. You can mark tasks as done with a single tap, ensuring better organization and time management.

The finance tracker allows you to log your income, expenses, and savings. You can categorize transactions to understand your spending habits better. A visual pie chart helps you analyze your financial status at a glance.

The health and fitness section includes a workout tracker and a calorie tracker. The workout tracker allows you to add workouts and mark them as completed. The calorie tracker calculates calories burned based on your BMR and lets you track food intake throughout the day. The data is visually represented in a pie chart to help you monitor your calorie balance.

Streaks help you set a goal and stick to it, mark your task everyday to keep track of your activities.

All data stays private and is stored locally on your device.

Start using ZenTrack today and take control of your productivity, finances, and fitness.
